title: Compact support duality is compatible with restricting to an open subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: With the notation of Lemma labelled lemma-duality-compact-support, for an open subscheme U' of U the lemma asserts that the square relating the two duality isomorphisms Hom_k(H^i(U, K), k) = H^{-i}_c(U, RSheafHom(K, omega)) and its primed version commutes, where the left vertical arrow is the contragredient of the restriction map and the right one is the covariance map of Remark labelled remark-covariance-open-lower-shriek (statement lines 9189-9207). The author opens the proof with 'We strongly urge the reader to skip this proof' but the argument is written out in full: choose X and M as in the proof of Lemma labelled lemma-duality-compact-support, drop the subscripts from RSheafHom and the derived tensor product, and write both H^i(U, K) and H^i(U', K|_{U'}) as colimits over the powers of ideals I and I' with I' contained in I chosen as in Remark labelled remark-covariance-open-j-lower-shriek, so that the restriction map is induced by the maps (I')^n -> I^n (proof lines 9209-9240). Similarly both compact support groups are written as limits of H^i(X, RSheafHom(M, omega) otimes^L I^n) and its primed version, so that the right vertical arrow is deduced from the same maps (proof lines 9242-9254). The first intermediate square commutes because the horizontal arrows of Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-internal-hom-evaluate are functorial in all three entries, and the remaining square commutes because the duality isomorphism Hom_k(H^i(X, L), k) = Ext^{-i}_X(L, omega) = H^{-i}(X, RSheafHom(L, omega)) is functorial in L in D_QCoh(O_X) (proof lines 9256-9273). Tracking the two functorialities, one in the powers of the ideals and one in the duality isomorphism, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
